headlines.title: Scarlett Johansson’s OpenAI clash is just the start of legal wrangles over artificial intelligence
Microsoft, OpenAI and Nvidia investigated over monopoly laws
U.S. Clears Way for Antitrust Inquiries of Nvidia, Microsoft and OpenAI
headlines.abstract: The Justice Department and the Federal Trade Commission agreed to divide responsibility for investigating three major players in the artificial intelligence industry.

headlines.title: Nvidia becomes world’s most valuable company amid AI boom
Nvidia Becomes Most Valuable Public Company, Topping Microsoft
headlines.abstract: The chip maker’s stock price has jumped over the last year thanks to its stranglehold on the market for the chips needed to build A.I. systems.
